description: This file defines an abstract class 'Mapping' for Drupal views style plugins, handling field mappings, options configuration, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Mapping
classes.description: An abstract class for mapping fields to specific use cases within Drupal views style plugins.

methods.name: defineMapping
methods.description: Abstract method to define the mapping configuration for fields.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines plugin options, including field mappings and toggle options.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for configuring field mappings, including toggles and filters.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Provides variables for rendering the view with the defined field mappings.
